summary: Show received transcript image attachments and keep undecodable images retryable instead of displaying broken thumbnails

schema.detail: Uses existing attachment metadata without generated client or wire-contract changes.

compatibility.detail: Assistant and mailbox attachments use the same viewer-authorized, user-triggered image cache as sent images. Images remain loading until decoded; failures revoke their URL and permit retry.

recovery.detail: Revert this change if necessary; only transient viewer image state is affected.
